lead: Counted in January from the payroll, not from the website. The figure on how long people stay took us longest to agree to publish.

stats.title: Across three offices
stats.text: Hollerau, Nauwang and Kettbach. In a typical week, 22 of them work on a site.

stats.title: Median time people stay
stats.text: Measured over everyone who has left since 2010, not over the people still here.

stats.title: Apprentices trained since 1998
stats.text: Of these, 19 still work in surveying and 6 still work here.

stats.title: Spoken on our sites
stats.text: German, Turkish, Czech and Hungarian. On a shared building site, that helps more than you might expect.
